feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The best raced design is iteration 6 (score 683.7): base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, kd 0.5, sensors at y 0.07, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss last_direction. It finished 20/20 on the oval at 1.99 s and 20/20 on the s-bend at 2.25 s, with s-bend max_error 0.028 and oscillation 0.29. The slalom still went off_track in all 20 runs, but progress rose from 0.311 (iteration 5, base_speed 1.0) to 0.392, and max_error stayed near the 0.064 mean. That is the first clear movement on the slalom, and it came from speed alone, since iteration 5 had already ruled out sensor lead. This candidate changes only base_speed, from 0.9 to 0.85, so any change in result is attributable to speed. The s-bend completion_time has about 0.6 s of margin under the 2.9 s guard, and the oval has ample margin. Approve: it is a clean single-variable step from the best design, the trend is consistent across two steps, and racing gives the telemetry needed for the next decision. Read the race as follows. If slalom progress rises above about 0.45 with the oval still 20/20 and s-bend finishes at 17/20 or better, keep moving speed (base_speed 0.8 is the next probe, provided s-bend completion_time stays under 2.9 s). If the s-bend completion_time exceeds 2.9 s or s-bend finishes fall below 17/20, return base_speed to 0.9. If slalom progress stalls near 0.39 at 0.85, the limit is sensor reach at the sharpest bend: keep base_speed 0.85 and move the sensors to y 0.075. If s-bend oscillation rises above about 0.5 while the robot stays on the line, raise kd to 0.6 with base_speed unchanged.
requested_changes: Keep base_speed at 0.85 and everything else as in iteration 6. The slalom progress rose 0.311 to 0.392 when base_speed went from 1.0 to 0.9, so speed through the sharp turns is the lever being tested.

If slalom progress rises above about 0.45 with the oval still 20/20 and the s-bend completion_time under 2.9 s, try base_speed 0.8 next. If the s-bend completion_time exceeds 2.9 s or s-bend finishes fall below 17/20, return base_speed to 0.9.

If slalom progress stalls near 0.39 at base_speed 0.85, keep base_speed 0.85 and move the sensors to y 0.075 for more lead at the sharpest bend. If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.5, raise kd to 0.6 instead, keeping base_speed fixed.
